name: Sergey Kozlov custom firmware (Tesla-style units)
about: Paid custom firmware by Sergey Kozlov for Tesla-style vertical head units. A seller lists PX3/PX6 units (Phoenix, Rhino, Linkswell, AuCar MK5, MK3 and others) on Android 7.1, 8.1 and 9. CleanYourHeadUnit has no verified way to recognise it, so the owner declares it.

developer.name: Sergey Kozlov
developer.note: Official page on Boosty. No GitHub username could be verified.

policy.themes: The firmware has its own themes; CleanYourHeadUnit themes are not applied to it.

limitations: Detection is by declaration only (cyhu --firmware sergey-kozlov, or the switch in the app's Settings).
With this profile, every vendor package not on the generic list stays Unknown, and nothing is Recommended.
CleanYourHeadUnit never flashes, downloads or redistributes this firmware.
restore_notes: Only pm disable-user is used; pm enable brings every package back. The firmware itself is never touched.
